newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian share prices ease in high volume.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian share prices ease in high volume.

text.p: Lithuanian shares eased amid active trade on Tuesday for the second straight day as a recent bull run seemed to have lost steam, dealers said.
Market volume was more than 5.6 million litas while the group A index fell by 288.36 points to 2,748.12.
"We expected prices to or fall a bit this week. Prices were rising a bit too quickly and are now nearing a level where they should stay for a while," one dealer said.
The blue chip stocks to fall included Birzai Milk, which dropped to 13.13 litas from 16.41 litas against an almost 20 percent rise on Monday.
Lithuania Gas fell by almost 20 percent for the second straight day, to 1.90 litas from 2.37 litas.
Hermis Bank also plunged 20 percent, to 196.00 litas from 245.00 litas in trade of 305,000 litas.
Defying the downward trend, market leader Vilnius Bank saw its preference stock rise by 20 percent to 1,800 litas in trade worth 90,000 litas.
Dealers were unsure about whether the easing of share prices would rekindle interest in the domestic debt market, where yields have been relatively low for several months now.
Over three million litas worth of bloc trades were made on Tuesday.
